---
title: "Day 3 – Robustness and the multiverse"
---
Day 3 moves from reproduction to robustness. It sets out the question behind the claim and the choices that lie between the data and a result, explains the methods behind each choice, and gives most of its time to independent work: each participant designs an analysis, preregisters it, runs it and adds it to the class chart, where it sits beside the results of the class and the 192 specifications of the curve of the claim.

| Session | What happens | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 1 – The estimand and the graph | The estimand statement behind the claim, and the causal graph that says what each adjustment does. | [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd), Task 2 of the workspace |
| 2 – The specification menu | Every decision on the menu of the case, the options of each and the methods behind them: [Scales and their reliability](../../companion/measurement.qmd), [survey weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd), [fixed effects, random intercepts and few clusters](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd), [respondents in countries](../../companion/individual-level.qmd). | [Specification menu](../../cases/trust/menu.qmd), [decision map](../../cases/trust/map.qmd) |
| 3 – A design of your own | Independent work: choose one option for each decision, fill in the preregistration block of the report, and send an exploration to the class chart before you declare. | Tasks 4 and 5 of the workspace |
| 4 – The multiverse | The declared analysis run, reported and sent to the class chart; the chart read against the curve of the claim, the five reanalyses and the replications; what a curve can and cannot establish. | [Multiverse](../../cases/trust/multiverse.qmd), [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |

**By the end of the day** you have a preregistered analysis of your own, run and reported, and you can place it among the defensible alternatives and say what the curve of the claim does and does not show.
